objectives.description: Ask type/choice/purpose, ownership and experience questions and answer them without repeating every full question.
objectives.rationale: Category nouns and inherited question words combine with exact A2-F034 ADV cuánto/F089 durar for duration, distinct from A1 noun-linked DET and price-only ADV. A2-F013 alguno + F090 vez and supported tense dependencies cover experience questions; no full-question row is needed.

objectives.description: Seek or give confirmation, correct an assumption and distinguish a confirmation tag from a truth noun.
objectives.rationale: Verdad tag contrasts inherited no tag and ordinary sí/no assertions; responder/contestar and F reference/negation handle correcting an assumption. Replying is not automatically agreement.

objectives.description: Ask and state a modest viewpoint without advanced argumentative positioning.
objectives.rationale: Para mí and inherited creer/pensar supply bounded viewpoint; exact A1-D versus A2-P/F mental-verb conflicts are retained. Elaborate position/rebuttal stays later.

objectives.description: Evaluate a familiar experience, compare alternatives and qualify an assessment.
objectives.rationale: Event-evaluation qué tal, practical positive assessments and exact F comparison adjectives/degree terms supply choice and experience assessment. Word quality and pragmatic acceptance are not automatically separate entries.

objectives.description: Express agreement/disagreement, invite agreement and qualify acceptance.
objectives.rationale: Estar de acuerdo and ordinary negation distinguish opinion agreement/dissent; inferential entonces and inherited pero qualify agreement without another full-sentence entry.

objectives.description: Distinguish knowing, being sure, uncertainty, dependence on circumstances and possibility.
objectives.rationale: Seguro/probable, factual saber, bounded puede ser and depende distinguish certainty, likelihood and contextual reservation; dependent complements and earliest levels remain explicit.

objectives.description: State a personal or general requirement and distinguish its absence from prohibition.
objectives.rationale: Exact F tener que/hay que and shared necesario distinguish requirements from no need; prohibition has its separate prohibido/poder permission context. Negative hay que cannot be translated mechanically as always optional.

objectives.description: Ask about and report remembering or forgetting without duplicating the factual-knowledge system.
objectives.rationale: Recordar/acordarse de/olvidar cover recall and failure of recall; transitive versus pronominal complement forms and A1/A2/B1 evidence remain unresolved global decisions, not deferred enumeration.

objectives.description: Ask and state liking, strong liking, aversion, interest and preference.
objectives.rationale: Inherited gustar/preferir plus encantar/odiar/interesar/favorito cover liking, intensity, aversion, interest and choice. Preferir explicitly retains A1-D versus A2-P conflict.

objectives.description: Ask and state wants or softened wishes with bounded form support.
objectives.rationale: Inherited querer supplies actual desire meaning; excluded independent gustaría row records required bounded softened-wish practice in the gustar family. No new word count for a conditional inflection.

objectives.description: Ask or state intended arrangements and whether a proposed time is suitable.
frameworkSections: Functions 3.9–3.10; approved me viene bien seed
objectives.rationale: Quedar, venir bien and F ir a support meeting intention/suitability; available/confirm/cancel link exact shared arrangement meanings. Calendar/time/contact slots remain prerequisites.

objectives.description: React with pleasure, regret, relief, surprise or admiration while distinguishing affected person from stimulus.
objectives.rationale: General sentir versus regret sentir, affection querer, relief/pain markers and pena/lástima distinguish reactions. Inherited F exclamative qué and P mood/state vocabulary compose the remaining responses.

objectives.description: Request an object, a favour or help; offer help and understand a polite instruction.
objectives.rationale: Favor, temporary-lending dejar and inherited dar/ayudar/poder/por favor cover help/object/instruction exchanges. Indirect command force is supported grammar/pragmatic practice, not a new transfer sense.

objectives.description: Accept, decline or withhold commitment to a request without presenting a refusal as an agreement.
objectives.rationale: Claro/bueno and inherited vale/sí/no distinguish ready, reserved and negative responses. Refusal can give ordinary no + inability/want/need plus reason; no automatic refusal formula for every sentence.

objectives.description: Ask, grant or deny permission and recognize a simple prohibition.
objectives.rationale: Inherited A1 bounded poder permission, permiso/prohibido and explicitly unresolved se puede provide consent/prohibition contrasts. Impersonal se is a prerequisite gap for later authoring, not falsely supplied by reflexive se.

objectives.description: Propose an activity and offer a routine suggestion without coercion.
objectives.rationale: Por qué no and qué tal si supply bounded proposal frames with inherited alternative o, prospective ir a and real-condition si. Literal why-not use and proposal force remain distinct.

objectives.description: Invite someone or offer to pay, distinguishing the two meanings; seek plan confirmation.
objectives.rationale: Invitation-to-participate and invitation-to-pay are separate invitar meanings; parecer practical assessment checks fit. Same forms do not imply every host pays.

objectives.description: Accept or decline an invitation with a condition, brief reason or alternative arrangement.
objectives.rationale: De acuerdo accepts a plan; inherited no/pero/porque plus supported condition si allow declining, explaining and offering alternatives. Quedar/time/calendar components provide another arrangement without adding every full sentence.

objectives.description: Give a routine suggestion for action and signal immediate caution.
objectives.rationale: Conveniente/cuidado plus shared tener que/hay que/poder and positive imperative forms cover routine advice and caution. No medical recommendations or remote safety claims are authored.

objectives.description: Attract attention and respond in face-to-face and telephone settings.
objectives.rationale: Oye/mira/perdona phatic forms and respectful dígame establish contact; tú/usted/plural and discourse-versus-literal roles need explicit authoring treatment.

objectives.description: Introduce people with familiar/respectful forms and respond conventionally.
objectives.rationale: Shared presentar plus mucho gusto and inherited encantado cover introducing and acknowledging people; person names, personal a and clitic forms remain F/P prerequisites.

objectives.description: Welcome someone and acknowledge the welcome.
objectives.rationale: Bienvenido agrees with recipients and inherited gracias acknowledges the welcome; de nada can respond to thanks but is not mislabeled the welcome response itself.

objectives.description: Apologize for an action and acknowledge an apology without duplicating regret intensification.
objectives.rationale: Expanded regret sentir + infinitive contrasts inherited lo siento/perdón; vale/bien acknowledgment is compositional, not another apology sense. Different-subject subjunctive regret remains later.

objectives.description: Congratulate, wish success/travel/meal enjoyment and respond appropriately.
objectives.rationale: Congratulations and success/travel/meal wishes with reciprocal response are enumerated. Birthday/holiday/well-being wishes use the relevant P/C/S nouns and fixed bounded forms; not productive unrestricted subjunctive.

objectives.description: Use a bounded familiar written opening/closing and neutral message sign-off.
objectives.rationale: Querido and familiar abrazo/besos contrast neutral saludos; message/channel and relationship register matter. Formal administrative closings are later, not required A2 casual-message words.

objectives.description: Identify caller, request a person or extension, wait, recognize wrong number/unavailability and leave a message.
objectives.rationale: Caller/on-behalf-of de parte de, request-a-person hablar/llamar, phone ponerse, extension, wait formula, mistake equivocar and recado/mensaje cover routing. Availability, current location/negation and number spelling are shared prerequisites.

objectives.description: Invite an account, begin a brief account and accept or politely prevent it.
objectives.rationale: Event-evaluation qué tal invites an account; contar/pasar and es que start a bounded telling/explanation. Preventing an account can use pause/time-pressure/no-now components, not another invented sentence.

objectives.description: Signal continued listening and distinguish interested uptake from factual agreement.
objectives.rationale: Ajá and deliberate escuchar versus oír perception distinguish attention from agreement or understanding. Sí can be a backchannel in context; echo/interest contours need audio review.

objectives.description: Order and conclude a short chronological account without a full rhetorical essay structure.
objectives.rationale: Primero/luego/por último, temporal versus inferential entonces, por eso and current-state ya/todavía organize short accounts; al final/de repente are explicit A2-versus-B1 proposals, not settled relevels.

objectives.description: Request explanation/repetition/spelling or correct a misunderstanding; retain the unresolved naming-frame se dependency.
objectives.rationale: Repetir/entender/explicar/significar, inherited question/answer/decir and exact A1 spelling deletrear cover repetition, meaning, spelling and correction. Cómo se dice nonreflexive se remains a named unresolved grammar prerequisite.

objectives.description: Ask for a pause, interrupt courteously and close a conversation without falsely accepting a proposal.
objectives.rationale: Un momento, time-pressure/departure and noncommittal bueno/pues help pause or close; inherited perdón, silence and farewell families supply polite interruption/ending. A transition is not necessarily consent.

objectives.description: Express simple dissatisfaction, identify the problem and ask for a practical correction, not pursue a legal claim.
objectives.rationale: Problema/queja, malfunction/repair/change and evaluative degree distinguish problem identification and practical correction. Formal remedies/reembolso retain later conflicts; no legal entitlement or warranty policy is implied.

objectives.description: Reuse knowing information, knowing a person and learned ability in affirmative/negative forms.
objectives.rationale: A1-D-004/082 and A1-F-261 distinguish factual saber, acquaintance conocer and learned-skill saber; poder ability from A1 expansion is separate. Added degree, compound tense or topic does not create a new knowing sense.

objectives.description: Reuse person/object/place description and routine/past events from their owning topical cells.
objectives.rationale: A1/A2 P/H/T/W/C/S enumerate the described people, objects, places and events; F provides reference, qualities, time and aspect. D supplies discourse organization, not new senses for longer examples.

objectives.description: Reuse greetings, thanks, response to thanks, condolences, toasts and familiar farewells.
objectives.rationale: A1-D-026–029/054–069 and exact A1 social plans provide these bounded families. A2 reception in another context or an intensifier is not a second lexical entry.

objectives.description: Reuse the complete ordinary feeling/body/health contrasts from P rather than repeat their domain inventory.
objectives.rationale: A2-P differentiates contento/triste/enfadado/nervioso/preocupado, affect and body needs; A1-P immediate heat/cold/hunger/thirst/sleep exceptions remain. Shared experiencer constructions and reaction markers selected here do not certify all emotional or medical terminology.

objectives.description: Keep object reference, tense/form and nonreflexive-se dependencies explicitly unresolved where not delivered by F.
objectives.rationale: A2-F pronoun/anaphora/inflection dependencies cover bounded objects, referents, past and prospective constructions. A1-F-030 reflexive/pronominal se and A2-F-030 le/les replacement do NOT provide impersonal/passive se for cómo se dice or se puede; F/W/D must explicitly adjudicate these frames and agreement before authoring.

objectives.description: Distinguish familiar/respectful forms and polite versus abrupt force without fabricated listening approval.
objectives.rationale: F/P person/clitic paradigms, W 27-letter alphabet and valid regional variants remain dependencies. Connected phrase stress, echo versus ordinary questions, pause/turn-taking, written openings and device es-ES/audio review must be checked later; no all-questions-rise rule.

objectives.description: Account for gaze, pointing and turn-yielding without inventing lexical entries.
objectives.rationale: Nonverbal interaction is relevant to skill practice but not a lexical-sense inventory. Accessible multimodal practice is a separate course-design responsibility.

objectives.description: Account for blank A1/A2 framework headings and genuinely later rhetorical/interactional systems.

Reconcile A1-D-053 and named P/F/W/C proposals; same meaning is not another net-new D count.

Explicit B1-F-010 retains same planned depender de at B1 versus this bounded A2 circumstance-dependent proposal. Bare depende scope versus full complement family requires global decision.

selections.lowerLevelContrast: A1 poder ability/permission is not this epistemic acknowledgement that something might be true.
